title: token_store: raw token never stored; SHA-256 hash only; constant-time verify
description: mail/token_store.rs generates 32 random bytes, returns base64url to caller once, stores only SHA-256 hash. Verification is constant-time hash comparison. DB compromise does not expose raw tokens. Tests cover issuance, expiry, revocation, ownership. This pattern should be used as a model for any future token system in the codebase.
